name: Zagros Basin

grid.height_format: u16le, row-major, row 0 = z -600, col 0 = x -600

wall.note: reserved; no asset yet, not placed on this map

notes: Fictional sector inspired by the character of Zagros foothills and a dry basin. SYNTHETIC terrain (procedural; no real elevation data). All settlements, roads, supply sites and derricks are invented. 1200 x 1200 game metres represent ~5 km; vertical relief is exaggerated for the RTS camera. facing_deg / yaw_deg are Godot rotation_degrees.y (0 = facing -Z, 90 = facing -X). Movement cost per cell = sum(splat weight x material cost) (sand = remainder), blended to the road cost by the road mask; a cell is impassable for a class when its slope exceeds max_slope_deg. See docs/MAP_ZAGROS_BASIN.md.
